item.title: Seismic Tremor Shakes Northwestern Kashmir
item.description: Seismic Tremor Shakes Northwestern Kashmir A significant earthquake struck northwestern Kashmir in India, registering a magnitude of 6, according to the European Mediterranean Seismological Center (EMSC).The seismic activity was recorded at a depth of 35 kilometers, adding a layer of complexity to the region's geological profile.Authorities are assessing the impact as the densely populated area comes to grips with the disruption.
